allocation: Within each outer-training stratum order groups by SHA256(seed|outer_fold|association_group); take round(0.2*n), half-up, bounded to [1,n-1] when n>=2 as inner_dev. A singleton stays inner_fit and is reported. No outcome/state-driven retries.
ownership: Encoder, input normalization, condition normalization and normal reference fit only on inner_fit; inner_dev selects checkpoint without fitting statistics; outer_held_out evaluates once after design frozen.
scope: Metadata and support counts only; no model, forward, optimizer, GPU or Test/Real reads.
